name: Eeva Mäkinen
bio:
Eeva's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working as a statistician for a logistics company, she developed an algorithm to optimize delivery routes, reducing fuel consumption significantly. A chance encounter with a Hitech GP engineer at a conference led to a discussion on applying similar principles to race strategy. Intrigued, Eeva delved into the world of racing data, quickly recognizing patterns and opportunities others missed. 

Joining Hitech GP five years ago, Eeva has become an invaluable asset. Her approach is methodical and data-driven, focusing on uncovering subtle performance advantages through rigorous analysis. She excels at identifying trends in telemetry and competitor data, providing actionable insights to the race engineers and drivers. Eeva is known for her ability to translate complex data into clear and concise recommendations, making her a highly effective communicator within the team. She's particularly proud of her contributions to improving tire management and race pace consistency.

Eeva's dedication extends beyond the racetrack. She actively mentors junior analysts, fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration within the team. Her ambition lies in building a world-class data analytics department at Hitech GP, ensuring the team remains at the forefront of technological advancements in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail
physical.description: Eeva is of average height with a focused gaze that conveys her analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with statistical formulas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard for all her data entry, claiming it improves accuracy.
